DHAKA, June 9 (Reuter) - Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to strengthen on Monday after a brief downward correction last week, brokers said. "The investors see prices (as) attractive after the shares fell on profit taking last week," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed. Brokers, however, said investors might remain cautious ahead of Thursday's government budget for fiscal 1997/98 (July-June). The DSE all-share price index rose 26.07 points or 2.32 percent to 1,167.91 on turnover of 67.8 milllion taka on Sunday. Friday and Saturday are the weekend in Bangladesh. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
